_comment: FTS BM25 index ranks observations by relevance. Setup seeds two pages with distinctive vocabulary; the query searches for a rare term that should appear in exactly one page. The assertion only locks the matching slug appearing in stdout (not exact rank) — BM25 weights can shift slightly across DuckDB versions.
setup: - [fact] research about an unusual creature called quokka ^[t:1]
- [fact] entirely unrelated content about marine biology ^[t:1]
cmd: SELECT slug FROM observations WHERE fts_main_observations.match_bm25(obs_uid, 'quokka') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fts_main_observations.match_bm25(obs_uid, 'quokka') DESC LIMIT 1;
